scripts.serve: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:start
scripts.shell: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest functions:shell
scripts.ml:docker:tenants: docker compose -f ../docker-compose.server.yaml exec novooa-ml python -m novooa_ml.tenants list
scripts.local-runtime:docker:wait-healthy: port=${NOVOOA_RUNTIME_PORT:-8090}; i=0; until curl -sf http://localhost:$port/healthz >/dev/null; do i=$((i+1)); if [ $i -ge 12 ]; then echo 'Runtime healthz nach 60s nicht erreichbar.' >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 5; done; echo "Runtime laeuft: http://localhost:$port"
scripts.local-runtime:docker:deploy: npm run ml:docker:up && npm run local-runtime:docker:down && npm run local-runtime:docker:up && npm run local-runtime:docker:wait-healthy
scripts.local-runtime:docker:down-all: npm run local-runtime:docker:down && npm run ml:docker:down
